prompt:
Indian urban residential house on a 30 ft x 40 ft plot.

IMPORTANT SITE RULES:
- SOUTH-FACING road and primary pedestrian entrance.
- G+2 / three-storey house.
- Half-parking intent: provide only ONE front car parking bay, not full-floor parking.
- Keep substantial residential use on the ground floor.
- Main door must connect directly into a foyer or living circulation.
- Ground floor must not be a collection of disconnected boxes.
- Rooms must form one continuous architectural floor plate.
- No meaningless internal voids between rooms.
- Staircase must be practical and remain vertically aligned through all floors.
- Do not overlap staircase, toilets, bedrooms or circulation.
- Upper floors must connect directly to the same stair core.
- Prefer vertically stacked toilets/wet areas.
- Kitchen must connect logically to dining.
- Bedrooms must have privacy and usable proportions.
- Toilets must not open directly into the kitchen.
- Provide exterior windows to habitable rooms.
- Provide realistic doors and circulation.
- Use compact Indian residential planning proportions.

VASTU PREFERENCES:
- Main entrance appropriate for SOUTH-facing plot.
- Master bedroom preferred toward south-west.
- Kitchen preferred toward south-east where practical.
- Pooja / prayer space preferred toward north-east where practical.
- Vastu preferences must not create disconnected rooms or unusable geometry.

DRAWING REQUIREMENT:
Generate coordinated floor plans for Ground, First and Second floors.
The 2D plans should look like a professional architectural residential layout:
continuous walls, connected rooms, door openings, stair flights, toilets,
kitchen, living/dining spaces, bedroom labels and sensible circulation.
Avoid isolated floating rectangles.
